body_preview: - Trajectory graph pressure: deepseek_model_call_unmatched_completed_count=1 "ModelCallCompleted without a corresponding ModelCallStarted" - append_terminal_state_events.py detects these orphans and reports them as lifecycle gaps. A non-zero count means at least one ModelCallCompleted was recorded while no model call ID was tracked as active. - The functions
expected_evidence: After the fix, the next trajectory run shows deepseek_model_call_unmatched_completed_count dropping to 0 (or not incrementing on new sessions). The state event stream no longer contains ModelCallCompleted events with no preceding ModelCallStarted in the same run. Implementation Notes: The current model call ID is tracked via a global `Mutex<Option<String>>`
title: Add model call lifecycle guard for unmatched completed events
